notation.generated P s S: B join subgroup closure of chosen s_i in S

semantic_obligations.generated_inter: full generated-subgroup intersection equality from proved recognition
semantic_obligations.chosen_not_in_others: omitting a choice cannot generate it
semantic_obligations.generates_top: finite type set: all choices and the common stabilizer generate the ambient group
